title: Excess Flood Paid-Up Credit on HomeFlood Installments
content:
**Rule.** A HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies installment carries an Excess paid-up credit. The credit reads the customer's Tidemark Excess Flood policy — a policy of the Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines) — in status active at the same property address. The Excess Flood program allows only one live policy on an address.

| Excess Flood policy at the HomeFlood address | Premium balance it shows | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| active | zero or less | 1 percent of the later-installment share |
| active | above zero (a balance owed) | 0.5 percent of the later-installment share |
| none active | — | none |

**Form of the credit.** The credit is taken off the installment due. The later-installment share is the plan's later share of the term premium item booked for the installment's term.

**Records read.** The Excess Flood policy record is read for its status, its property address and its premium balance.

*Hypothetical illustration:* a later-installment share of 400.00 with an active, fully paid Excess Flood policy at the address earns 4.00. If that policy still owed money, the credit would be 2.00.
